about_the_game:
The Faded World

In a village where people have lost their colors and can no longer possess them, "Fade" is born with the unique ability to hold color.

 

Soul Wonder is a pixel-art, retro-style 2D action roguelike game.

It features side-scrolling gameplay where players must dodge various enemy attacks and utilize powerful weapons to progress.

-Game Features

Various Weapons and Playstyles

Start by choosing 2 out of 5 different weapons to build your own unique playstyle.

 

Each weapon has 4 different "Weapon Form Enhancements" that transform both basic attacks and skills when upgraded.

 

Additionally, "Weapon Stat Enhancements" allow you to strengthen your weapons further, making battles more favorable.

Diverse Themes and Enemies

The game features 5 unique themes, including snowy fields, forests, oceans, deserts, and castles, each with a distinctive atmosphere.

 

Over 40 types of regular enemies, 10 elite enemies, and formidable bosses await you.

 

Defeat the ruthless foes in this faded world and survive.

 

Relentless Threats

The longer you stay in a stage, the more unpredictable threats—such as black owls and lightning—will appear.

 

Survive as long as possible, gather upgrade materials, and move on to the next stage.

 

The Ultimate Challenge

If you manage to progress through all the stages, a powerful boss will appear at the end of each chapter.

 

Test the strength you've built up so far, defeat the boss, and claim ultimate victory!

 

Planned Features After the Beta Version

  • Weapon Upgrade System
    All weapons will receive at least one enhancement option to diversify gameplay and customization.

  • Expanded Farming Mechanics
    Players will be able to obtain accessories and other items by defeating monsters, enhancing the loot farming experience.

  • Boss Monsters
    Each chapter will introduce a unique boss monster, with a total of five new bosses planned. Defeating all of them will unlock the final boss challenge.

name: SoulWander

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+), Windows 10 and Windows 11
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, ARM64.
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 capable.
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 747 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Hardware vendor officially supported drivers.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Mojave 10.14+
  • Processor: Apple Silicon, x64 architecture with SSE2.
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal capable Intel and AMD GPUs
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Apple officially supported drivers.

short_description: Soul Wander is a moving journey to restore lost colors and light to a dark world. Can you find the light in this darkness? Each region has its own story. Grow stronger with weapons and soul powers. Your choices shape the world’s fate. Begin your quest to reclaim lost colors now!
